SYMPTOM: cargo check failed on Windows with two types of errors in Windows-specific code
FIX 1 — GlobalFree import:
  BEFORE: use windows_sys::Win32::System::Memory::GlobalFree
  AFTER: use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::GlobalFree
  (moved in newer windows-sys crate version)
FIX 2 — into_owned() on String:
  BEFORE: String::from_utf16_lossy(&wide).into_owned()
  AFTER: String::from_utf16_lossy(&wide)
  (newer Rust/windows: from_utf16_lossy returns String directly, not Cow — into_owned() doesn't compile)
COMMITTED: Both fixes committed to main in the Windows port commit batch
